questions.question: Discuss the impact of sweat rate on fluid replacement strategies.
questions.solution_html:
• o Fluid replacement planning: Knowing an athlete’s sweat rate helps estimate how
  • much fluid needs to be consumed before, during, and after exercise to prevent
  • dehydration or overhydration. ((2 marks))
  • o Performance impact: If fluid loss isn’t replaced according to sweat rate, dehydration
  • can reduce endurance, increase heart rate and body temperature, and impair
  • performance. ((2 marks))

  • performance by improving energy availability, strength, and endurance. ((2 marks))

  • promote faster recovery after exercise. ((2 marks))

questions.question: Discuss the importance of antioxidants in reducing exercise-induced muscle damage.
questions.solution_html:
• o During intense exercise, the body produces free radicals (reactive oxygen species)
  • that can damage muscle cells. ((2 marks))
  • o Antioxidants such as vitamins C, E, beta-carotene, and compounds from fruits and
  • vegetables help neutralize these free radicals, preventing cell damage. ((2 marks))
questions.final_answer: vegetables help neutralize these free radicals, preventing cell damage. ()

questions.question: Explain the objectives and functions of NADA in controlling doping practices in sports.
questions.solution_html:
• Objective ((2marks))
  • o The main objective of the National Anti-Doping Agency (NADA) is to promote
  • fair play and integrity in sports by ensuring that all athletes compete in a drug-free
  • environment.
  • o It aims to prevent and control doping practices in India in line with the World
  • Anti-Doping Code (WADA).
  • Functions ((8 marks))
  • o Testing and Monitoring: Conducts dope tests on athletes during and outside
  • competitions to detect prohibited substances or methods.
  • o Education and Awareness: Educate athletes and coaches about the dangers and
  • consequences of doping.
  • o Result Management and Sanctions: Handles the results of doping tests and
  • imposes penalties or suspensions on athletes found guilty of violations.
  • o Coordination with WADA and Sports Bodies: Works with the World Anti
  • Doping Agency (WADA) and national sports federations to ensure compliance
  • with anti-doping regulations.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the role and importance of post-event recovery meals in sports performance.
questions.solution_html:
• Importance of Post-Event Meals ((2 marks))
  • o After intense physical exertion, the body enters a catabolic state where glycogen
  • stores are depleted, muscle tissue is damaged, and fluids along with electrolytes
  • are lost. ((1 mark))
  • o Consuming a post-event meal is crucial for recovery, helping to restore balance
  • and initiate the healing process. ((1 mark))
  • Key Roles of Post-Event Meals ((8 marks))
  • o Replenishing Glycogen Stores - Carbohydrates are essential to refill glycogen
  • levels that are diminished during exercise. Simple carbs, like fruits, are effective
  • immediately after an event.
  • o Repairing Muscle Tissue- Protein intake is vital to promote muscle recovery.
  • o Restoring Hydration - Rehydration is critical. Replace lost fluids with water and
  • electrolyte solutions to support recovery.
  • o Supporting Immune Function - Adequate nutrition helps bolster the immune
  • system, which can be compromised after intense physical activity.
  • (1x10=10)
